newsitem.title: DUBAI: India's Wockhardt in Saudi venture.
newsitem.headline: India's Wockhardt in Saudi venture.

text.p: Indian pharmaceutical maker Wockhardt is setting up a joint venture plant in Saudi Arabia, a Saudi newspaper reported on Monday.
The $10 million venture, Wockhardt Middle East Ltd, will be set up near Riyadh and will involve two local partners -- Al Mintakh and MAS, the English-language Arab News said.
It was quoting an Indian embassy newsletter.
Wockhardt will have a 50 percent stake in the venture.

The plant will concentrate on pharmaceutical formulations and veterinary products and will produce a range of 30 to 40 goods including antibiotics, cardiovascular and anti- inflammatory products, analgesics and anti-asthma and cough formulations.

Saudi Arabia is one of the Middle East's largest consumers of pharmaceutical products with the market valued at more than three billion riyals ($800 million) a year, of which local production accounts for less than 15 percent.
